limitations.quote: I’ll update each pointer on the edge that accepts its transaction and generate each status flag in its own clock domain.
limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the zero write increment but also changed when the Gray pointers and full/empty flags update and added reset gating to the RAM enables, whereas the correct patch preserves that behavior.

The scoreboard used the DUT’s own flags to decide which transfers occurred and checked settled fill and drain states, so it could verify FIFO ordering without detecting cycle-by-cycle flag timing mismatches.
The knowledge-base searches surfaced transcript matches but yielded no actionable finding that informed the fix.
